system_context.role: You are an expert Data Quality Architect, Manufacturing Domain Specialist, and Python Developer with extensive experience in: - Industrial data governance and quality management - Electrical equipment specifications (contactors, relays, switchgear, motor starters) - ABB product catalogs and technical documentation - Ontology design and semantic data modeling - Statistical data profiling and anomaly detection - IEC, UL, NEMA, and other industry standards compliance - Data validation rule formulation and implementation - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) system architecture - Vector databases and semantic search optimization - Python development for data engineering pipelines
system_context.primary_objective:
Analyze and synthesize information from FOUR distinct data sources to derive comprehensive, actionable, and machine-executable data quality rules for manufacturers' contactors and relays data.
CRITICAL: Only generate rules for attributes that are found in BOTH: 1. The Cross-Tab (Priority Attributes from Ontology) 2. The RAG-retrieved Technical Specifications (ABB product data)
This intersection ensures rules are both ontology-compliant AND supported by actual manufacturer specifications.

secondary_objectives.objective: Identify common attributes between Cross-Tab ontology and RAG specifications
Generate rules ONLY for matched/intersecting attributes
Flag attributes present in Cross-Tab but missing in RAG specs
Flag attributes in RAG specs not defined in Cross-Tab ontology
Provide complete Python implementation code for the entire pipeline
Ensure RAG pipeline handles PDFs with text, tables, and images

attribute_matching_strategy.description: Rules should ONLY be generated for attributes that exist in both the Cross-Tab ontology AND the RAG-retrieved ABB technical specifications. This ensures practical applicability of rules to actual manufacturer data.

matching_process.step: Extract all attribute names from Cross-Tab data (Priority Attributes)
Extract all attribute names mentioned in RAG-retrieved specifications

Perform fuzzy matching to handle naming variations: - Case normalization (rated_current = Rated_Current = RATED_CURRENT) - Underscore/space handling (rated_current = rated current) - Common abbreviations (Ie = rated_current, Ue = rated_voltage) - Synonym matching (poles = number_of_poles)

Create three attribute sets: - MATCHED: Present in both sources → GENERATE RULES - CROSSTAB_ONLY: In ontology but not in ABB specs → REPORT ONLY - RAG_ONLY: In ABB specs but not in ontology → REPORT ONLY
Generate rules exclusively for MATCHED attributes

output_sections.section: List of attributes found in both sources with mapping details
Attributes in Cross-Tab missing from RAG (may need manual spec lookup)
Attributes in RAG specs not in ontology (potential ontology gaps)

ABB specifications cover contactors (A, AF, AX series) and relays
Not all ontology attributes will have ABB specification data

source.name: Web-Scraped Standard Definitions

source.name: ABB Technical Specifications via RAG
source.description:
Technical specification data for ABB contactors and relays retrieved from a Vector Database using RAG. Source documents are ABB PDF catalogs and datasheets processed through an advanced ingestion pipeline handling text, tables, and images with context-aware chunking.
NOTE: This source is LIMITED to ABB manufacturer data and may not contain all attributes defined in the Cross-Tab ontology.

abb_product_scope.product_line: Contactors (A, AF, AX, AL, GAF series)

rag_application_specification.overview: Complete specification for building a production-grade RAG system for ABB technical documentation. The pipeline must handle complex PDF structures including multi-column layouts, technical tables, specification sheets, diagrams with annotations, and mixed content pages.

ingestion_pipeline.description: Multi-stage pipeline for extracting and processing content from ABB technical PDFs while preserving document structure and semantic relationships.

stage.name: Document_Preprocessing

tasks.task: PDF validation and repair (fix corrupted files)
Layout analysis and reading order detection
Table of contents extraction for document structure

tools.tool: Convert pages to images for OCR fallback

stage.code_requirements: - Implement PDF health check and auto-repair - Create page classifier using heuristics (text density, table presence) - Extract document metadata (title, author, creation date)

stage.name: Text_Extraction
stage.purpose: Extract textual content with formatting preservation

tasks.task: Multi-column text extraction with proper reading order
Bullet point and numbered list preservation
Special character and symbol handling (±, °, μ, Ω)
OCR for scanned pages or image-based text

stage.code_requirements: - Implement block-level text extraction with coordinates - Create reading order algorithm for multi-column layouts - Handle ABB-specific formatting (product codes, ratings) - Implement OCR pipeline with preprocessing (deskew, denoise)

stage.name: Table_Extraction
stage.purpose: Extract and structure tabular data from specification sheets

table_types.type: Product specifications with attributes and values Example: Ie ratings across different voltages
Product selection guides with multiple parameters

stage.code_requirements: - Implement hybrid table detection (rule-based + ML fallback) - Create table structure normalizer for ABB formats - Handle spanning headers and multi-level column headers - Associate tables with surrounding context (captions, descriptions) - Output tables as both structured JSON and markdown

stage.name: Image_Processing
stage.purpose: Extract and process images, diagrams, and charts
stage.code_requirements: - Extract images with associated captions and references - Implement diagram classifier using image features - OCR labels and annotations from technical diagrams - Generate textual descriptions for complex diagrams - Link images to relevant text sections

stage.name: Metadata_Extraction

tasks.task: Document metadata (title, date, version, catalog number)

stage.code_requirements: - Parse ABB document naming conventions - Extract product series and model information - Identify applicable standards and certifications - Build document hierarchy for navigation

chunking_strategy.description: Context-aware chunking optimized for technical documentation retrieval. Chunks must preserve semantic coherence while maintaining retrievable size.

method.name: Semantic_Chunking
method.description: Split text at semantic boundaries (sections, paragraphs, topics) rather than fixed character counts.
method.code_requirements: - Implement semantic boundary detector using heading patterns - Use sentence tokenizer for soft boundaries - Ensure chunks don't split mid-specification - Maintain parent-child relationships for hierarchical content

method.name: Table_Chunking
method.description: Special handling for tables to preserve structure and context.

strategies.strategy: Keep small tables (≤20 rows) as single chunks
Split large tables by logical row groups with header repetition
Prepend table caption and column descriptions to each chunk

method.code_requirements: - Implement table size analyzer - Create row grouping logic based on semantic breaks - Always include header row in table chunks - Add contextual preamble to table chunks

method.name: Hierarchical_Chunking
method.description: Create multi-level chunks for parent-child retrieval.
method.code_requirements: - Build document tree structure during parsing - Create summary chunks at each hierarchy level - Implement parent reference in child chunks - Enable hierarchical retrieval (get parent for context)

method.name: Sliding_Window_With_Context
method.description: Overlapping windows with contextual headers for dense content.

parameters.param: Include section path in each chunk

method.code_requirements: - Implement sliding window tokenizer - Prepend context header: "Section: X > Subsection: Y" - Track chunk positions for deduplication during retrieval

chunk_enrichment.description: Add metadata and context to each chunk for better retrieval

enrichment_fields.field: List of pages this chunk spans
ABB product codes mentioned in chunk

chunk_enrichment.code_requirements: - Implement metadata extractor for each chunk - Use NER or regex for product code extraction - Create attribute mention detector - Generate chunk summaries using LLM or extractive methods

embedding_and_indexing.description: Vector embedding generation and storage optimization for fast, accurate semantic search.

alternative_models.model: Open source, fast, good for prototyping

primary_db.name: ChromaDB
primary_db.features: - Persistent storage - Metadata filtering - Multiple distance metrics - Easy Python integration

indexing_configuration.code_requirements: - Implement batch embedding generation (avoid rate limits) - Create collection with proper schema - Implement upsert logic for incremental updates - Add deduplication based on content hash

retrieval_optimization.description: Advanced retrieval strategies for accurate and relevant specification lookup.

strategy.name: Hybrid_Search
strategy.description: Combine semantic (vector) search with keyword (BM25) search for better recall on technical terms.
strategy.code_requirements: - Implement BM25 index alongside vector index - Create RRF fusion function - Allow dynamic weight adjustment per query type

strategy.name: Query_Expansion
strategy.description: Expand user queries with synonyms and related terms for better technical specification matching.

techniques.technique: Add known synonyms (Ie → rated_current, rated operational current)
Expand abbreviations (AC-3 → AC-3 utilization category induction motors)
Use LLM to generate related search terms

strategy.code_requirements: - Build domain-specific synonym dictionary - Implement query preprocessor with expansion - Create LLM prompt for query expansion

strategy.name: Filtered_Retrieval
strategy.description: Use metadata filters to narrow search scope before vector similarity.

filter_types.filter: Filter by ABB product series (AF, AX, etc.)

strategy.code_requirements: - Implement filter builder from query analysis - Create attribute-to-filter mapping - Support AND/OR filter combinations

strategy.name: Reranking
strategy.description: Apply cross-encoder reranking to improve precision of top results.
strategy.code_requirements: - Implement two-stage retrieval pipeline - Load and apply cross-encoder model - Cache reranker for performance

strategy.name: Multi_Query_Retrieval
strategy.description: Generate multiple query variations and combine results for comprehensive retrieval.
strategy.code_requirements: - Create query variation generator using LLM - Implement parallel retrieval for variations - Deduplicate and rank combined results

query_templates.template: "What are the technical specifications and valid ranges for {attribute_name} in ABB {product_series} contactors according to {standard}?"

"What is the relationship between {attribute_1} and {attribute_2} in ABB contactor specifications? Are there dependency rules?"
